newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Ceridian Corp cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Ceridian Corp cut.

text.p: -- Lehman Brothers said it downgraded Ceridian Corp to neutral from buy.
-- cut the 1997 earnings forecast by $0.05, to $2.70 a share.
-- set a new 12-month price target of $45 a share, down from previous estimate of $60.
-- said has concerns about deceleration in rate of revenue growth in 1997 in three of Ceridian's four businesses.
-- said 10-12 percent revenue growth may not be sufficient to sustain 20 percent earnings per share growth over the longer term.
-- Ceridian was off 2-1/4 to 36-3/4 in late morning trading.
